{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial sarlacc stabilizer''' was a massive device constructed by forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during their [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|invasion of Felucia]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. The device was built with the purpose of restraining the sarlacc creature that lived in the [[Ancient Abyss]]. When the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] arrived on the planet with the purpose of freeing [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], he sensed the sarlacc's suffering. Taking pity for the creature, he released it from the chains that held it.
